rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the previously mentioned nature
absolutive expressing prior act of knowing
compound describing a concealed essential reality
state of omniscience arising as result
verb indicating the emergence of that state

items.question: What state arises from knowing the hidden true nature?
premises: A hidden true nature exists as an object of knowledge.
Knowing that hidden true nature is possible.
All-knowingness arises as the result of that knowing.
items.inference: Knowing the hidden true nature gives rise to all-knowingness.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
